entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a jersey. Just give me a yes or no, can I do it? Order number is VF458-991B.

Okay, I can certainly look into that. Pulling up that order now... I see the Velocity Pro Jersey. To process this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is way too tight. I don't have time for a long call, I just need to know if I can get an exchange or my money back.
I understand completely. Let me just verify the delivery date... Okay, I see it arrived 21 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Yes, I am. I have just authorized the return for you. I'm sending an email with a pre-paid return label to the address on file right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, we'll process your full refund. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
